metas.name: ★ 1.2 · 2023 · Queen Cleopatra
metas.description: Netflix docudrama about Queen Cleopatra of Egypt of the Ptolemaic lineage from Macedonia, Greece, that ruled for 21 years, between the years 51 BC and 30 BC, ending with her suicide.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2019 · Leaving Neverland
metas.description: At the height of his stardom, the world's biggest pop star, Michael Jackson, began long-running relationships with two young boys, aged between seven and ten, along their families. They now allege that he sexually abused them.
